duration_bin_closure: left closed, right open; final bin [32,infinity)
excursion_path: actual entry fill anchor; full entry-through-pre-exit candles; raw exit open endpoint; no exit candle high/low/close
mae_mfe_policy: nonnegative excursions including entry-price anchor; both percent and actual quantity USDT
giveback_primary: MFE USDT minus signed quantity*(raw exit open - actual entry fill)
giveback_execution_adjusted: MFE USDT minus ledger gross_after_slippage; primary plus exit slippage, excludes fees
open_positions: separate output and marked-to-training-end; never included in closed-trade statistics
streak_policy: exit order; nonnegative net trade ends loss streak; directional sequences omit opposite direction trades
risk_period_accounting: S0 candle-open label attribution; daily UTC, weekly Monday-Sunday, calendar month; all MTM includes open position
drawdown_policy: bar-close MTM; actual close timestamps; recovery tolerance 1e-8 USDT for serialization rounding only
